name: CyScenarioBench
intro: CyScenarioBench 是 Irregular 构建的私有场景式网络安全评测框架，它从真实事件抽象攻击树，在全新高保真环境中衡量模型的任务、路径和完整战役级编排能力。
build_method: 从真实网络安全事件提取攻击者决策、约束和环境条件，形式化为带前置条件、依赖和能力要求的攻击树，再从零构建含容器化网络、真实操作系统/应用/防御、语音、人物和网站的全新私有环境
metric: 工作稿披露分支决策、约束遵循、上下文/累积推理漂移、死路与排障、最优策略偏离和不可能状态跳转等度量，但未给出统一评分公式
eval_feature: 任务级原子能力、路径级攻击树分支及战役级完整仿真三级评测；关注长程编排、适应与恢复，所有场景不来自公开 CTF 并保持私有
scale: 私有；完整或分版本题量未知。2026-06-26 的 GPT-5.6 Sol 下游配置使用 11 个场景，但不代表标准完整题库规模
build_method_en: Extract attacker decisions, constraints, and environmental conditions from real incidents; formalize attack trees with preconditions, dependencies, and capability requirements; then build fresh private environments from scratch with containerized networks, realistic operating systems/apps/controls, voice, personas, and websites
eval_feature_en: Three nested levels cover an atomic task, one attack-tree path, and a full campaign simulation; they assess long-horizon orchestration, adaptation, and recovery in private scenarios not derived from published CTFs
intro_en: CyScenarioBench is Irregular's private scenario-based cybersecurity framework. It abstracts attack trees from real incidents and measures task-, path-, and campaign-level orchestration in fresh high-fidelity environments.
scale_en: Private; full or versioned size is unknown. A 2026-06-26 GPT-5.6 Sol downstream configuration used 11 scenarios, not a canonical full-suite count
metric_en: The draft discloses branching decisions, constraint adherence, context/cumulative reasoning drift, dead ends and troubleshooting, optimal-policy divergence, and impossible state transitions, but no unified scoring formula

drawio_review_note: Aligned only to Irregular's mutable official working draft dated 2025-12-05, especially §§3–6; its HTTP response reported last-modified 2026-07-16 and the page was retrieved 2026-07-18 (ETag 94fb162f52cf829a97c3e72aaeaa20be). The HTTP header is provenance metadata, not a semantic benchmark version. CyScenarioBench has no independent paper, no public repository, and no public dataset. The disclosed construction path is real-incident analysis → extraction of decisions, constraints, and environmental conditions → attack trees with preconditions, dependencies, capability requirements, and environmental dependencies → fresh high-fidelity environments built from scratch with containerized network topologies, realistic operating systems/applications/security controls, voice modules, worker personas, and website/infrastructure surfaces. Scenarios do not reuse published CTFs or challenge archives and remain private. Models traverse an evolving constrained state space at task, path, and campaign levels. The draft records branching decisions, constraint adherence, context and cumulative reasoning drift, dead ends, troubleshooting, divergence from optimal decision policies, and hallucinated or impossible state transitions. It publishes no task count, no split, no scoring formula, no harness, no per-item outputs, and no leaderboard, and explicitly describes current long-horizon instrumentation as coarse. A separate Irregular report dated 2026-06-26 used 11 CyScenarioBench scenarios for one GPT-5.6 Sol testing configuration (7/11 solved at least once; 28% average success across attempts); those 11 are not a canonical full-suite size or a general scoring formula. Official sibling suites in that report are FrontierCyber and Atomic Challenges.
